style.house_sound: Rimtera sound: driving techno pulse and drum and bass breakbeats under funky classical strings and baroque runs, MIDI synth-pop leads, upbeat, classical with a semi-modern edge
style.choir: epic post-apocalyptic, very deep basso profundo male monk choir, slow sustained low chanting with long held vowels, Gregorian-style, invented words only
style.music_suffix: in a MIDI style: General MIDI sound-module instruments (synth leads, sampled strings, brass, a drum kit), 16-bit era like a classic sandbox game soundtrack, loopable
style.sfx_suffix: sci-fi frontier retro video game sound effect, MIDI and sound-module era, punchy and crunchy, synthetic with a slight bit-crushed edge, clean, close, no music, no speech
style.ambience_suffix: seamless ambient background loop, field recording style, no music, no speech

templates.music: {card}. {house_sound}. {choir}. {voice}, with a low droning hum underneath. video game {context} {music_suffix}

calm: [Intro - low monk drone alone, slow and wide]
[Verse - the music enters, monks hum low underneath]
[Chorus - the choir swells, slow held chant]
[Interlude - the melody leads, the drone holds]
[Outro - the drone holds and leads back to the start]
drive: [Intro - low monk drone, the beat builds in]
[Verse - driving groove, the low drone holds underneath]
[Chorus - full choir, slow half-time chant over the beat]
[Build - drums rise, the choir grows deeper]
fight: [Intro - low monk drone alone, ominous, war drums]
[Verse - the fight starts, the low drone holds underneath]
[Chorus - full choir, slow half-time chant over the driving fight]
[Bridge - strings and synth leads race, monks drone low]
[Build - drums double, the choir grows deeper]
[Chorus - overwhelming, full choir and full band]
